reviews.author: Su ZANGK
reviews.text: (Translated by Google) When I went at lunchtime, the place was crowded, and a waitress who appeared to be Chinese and dressed in black noticed us standing at the entrance for about 7 or 8 minutes. We made eye contact three times during that time, and only then did she approach us, ask who we were, and go back inside, completely ignoring us as guests. She even forced us to pay a service charge at the end, making it a truly terrible experience. As for the food, I can only describe the taste as mediocre, so I wouldn't say it was very delicious. Terrible… (Original) 점심때 갔을 때 안에 사람이 많았고, 검은 옷을 입은 중국인으로 보이는 종업원 한 분이 저희가 입구에 대략 7~8분 정도 서 있는 것을 보았다. 그동안 세 번 눈을 마주쳤고, 그제야 그녀가 다가와 저희 몇 명이 누구냐고 물은 뒤 다시 안으로 들어가 손님은 신경 쓰지 않았습니다. 마지막 서비스비까지 강제로 내게 해서, 정말 최악의 경험이었다. 음식은 맛이 그저 그렇다고밖에 말할 수 없어서, 아주 맛있다고는 안 한다. Terrible…

reviews.text: FOOD: Steak Tataki - presentation is really great, but the dish is cold, lukewarm at best (uneven temp). I was expecting hot or even atleast around 65C, but I don't know the proper standard temp for this dish. I could feel the grease of the beef in my mouth. Not great. But I don't waste food, so I have to eat it with difficulty hahaha and we came with high expectation so we came in really hungry from Carlisle. Chicken tonkatsu - okay Prawn Tempura - highly recommended Salmon Panko roll - highly recommended Strawberry lemonade - is a hit with and popping pearls, my girls did not like coconut jelly, but for me, I loved it. Watermelon lemonade - okay SERVICE: Great and quick ATMOSPHERE: We came in at lunch time, before they opened at 12, online said its 11:30 on Mondays. So we we re just huddlled by the door looking at menus. No friendly staff although there seem to be one working there, so we decided to walk and come back on the dot as we are only walk in customers, but we were accommodated by the staff. Nice and clean. Loved the geisha art staring down at you. Nice touch. If not for the screaming toddler beside our table I can give this a 3/4 star. So that was the whole dining experience today. I noticed 10% SC as I was paying. Only coz it was mentioned by the staff.

reviews.author: Layton
reviews.text: We had a bit of a strange experience here. The app charged me for sushi that I’d removed from my basket, which I didn’t realise until after I’d paid. I mentioned it to the waiter, who seemed just as baffled, so I ended up keeping the sushi anyway. Unfortunately, it was some of the worst sushi I’ve had. The app also automatically adds a tip, which you have to manually remove from your total. I find that quite odd? why am I being asked to tip before I’ve even had my food or received any service? Why am I being asked to tip at all for a QR code? The ramen broth was definitely the highlight of the meal, but overall, the rest was pretty disappointing especially as we were celebrating a birthday. Hopefully some improvements to the app and food quality are made, as there’s potential here.

reviews.author: Lime
reviews.text: Sadly, my experience at Maki & Ramen wasn't the best. I asked for a Tantan ramen without chili oil, and the waiter said he could ask the chef to use less chili oil than usual. I agreed, but what I got was probably the spiciest dish I have ever eaten in my entire life. Not only was there a huge amount of spicy oil, but there were also plenty of chili pepper pieces! The eggs were also simply boiled and not like the classic ramen eggs you would expect. My cousin ordered a Chicken Laksa. The menu described it as *"A Malaysian-inspired twist packed with lemongrass, galangal and garlic. Creamy coconut rounds out this fragrant, warming chicken broth for a bold, exotic experience."* However, there was no chicken in it at all! And of course she paid it the normal price. After leaving half of our ramen in our bowls, we tried several times to get the waiters' attention to explain what had happened. They either pretended not to see us or said, "One minute and I'll come to you," but then never came back. After 16 minutes of waiting, we were fed up and simply asked for the bill — and, surprisingly, we didn't have to wait for that. We will not be returning. We felt completely let down and, frankly, robbed, as we didn't receive what we ordered.

reviews.author: T C
reviews.text: Took my husband to Nottingham’s ‘Maki & Ramen’ for a birthday treat, it’s not really my first choice for food but thought I’d give it a go as it was about him on this day (09.08.26). Decor is lovely with a big ceiling dragon and cherry blossom, I like that they bang a gong whenever diners are taken to a seat. However the table isn’t very exciting, just plain black chopsticks and soy sauce. I loved all the post-it notes… I’ve been out for ramen three times in my life, unfortunately I didn’t really like my dish here, I had the steak ramen, steak itself was quite chewy, I enjoyed the half an egg and a few noodles but gave my husband the rest. He had a chicken and noodles dish which looked lovely and I wish I’d ordered that. This review is based on personal taste, I just don’t think ramen is for me. The two other places I’ve had ramen and did actually enjoy those meals and finished them were at The William Wygston in Wigston (a Wetherspoons so very basic) and by a long stretch Uzamaki in London was the best. Service here is very efficient and I would recommend to those who enjoy this kinda food. Husband thoroughly enjoyed both his meals!

reviews.author: Marek Marek
reviews.text: The food here is an absolute revelation, every dish was fresh, full of flavor, and prepared with the utmost care. The chefs definitely know what they are doing, and the culinary experience was top-notch. The service in the dining room was also efficient and friendly. Unfortunately, a big minus goes to the venue's policy regarding the service charge. It was automatically added to the bill upfront, and what's worse, no one informed us about it or asked if we agreed to it. Furthermore, the staff also failed to inform us that this fee could be opted out of entirely. I would have left a tip anyway because the food and the work of the waiters were worth it, but imposing a service fee in this manner is simply in bad taste and ruins a good impression. It's a shame that such a minor yet unfair practice hurts the image of the entire place. Despite everything, it's worth coming here just for the taste, but the staff should be more transparent with their customers.

reviews.text: This place was ok. The menus could have done with a wipe down. They were sticky. They are also big and bulky, especially the drinks menu. We were a table of 5 and wished to sit outside due to the lovely weather. The host was unsure as "the tables can't be moved" and made up for 2 or 4. We suggested to split and sit as a 2 and 3, not ideal as we are 2 adults and 3 children. We ended up with a chair at the end of our table but it blocked access to the table next to us. It was suggested we use the QR to order or pay upfront with the server. We opted to order via the QR, however you you can't order the kids bento on there. So we ended up doing that with the server. All a big fluff to be honest. Sorry we removed the pre added service charge when ordering because why pay service upfront? The staff were nice but this cost them a tip, as we didn't have cash to leave one. Food was ok, half of us enjoyed it and half didn't. We all had the same fried chicken but in different dishes. The deco' is lovely but could have done without the faux blossom flowers on the outside as they block the view of the lake. Those little things could make this place great. We will try again some time.

reviews.author: Grace Wood
reviews.text: Our first time here after a long day shopping. We read the menu and instantly wanted to eat it all! We were seating next to a fan after saying how hot it was. We ordered drinks and the steak ramen, and some panko sushi. Our food arrived before our drinks and the wait staff came over with drinks apologising for the delay in them. 2 minutes later, they came back and told us they had taken the drinks off our bill due to the wait!! We did not complain or ask for compensation so this was a lovely accomodation. The food was delicious and very flavourful. Especially as the sushi is prepared fresh at the counter. We both said we would be dreaming about the food tonight! Looking forward to enjoying something else from their menu soon. Hopefully, they open some other branches in different locations :)

reviews.author: Jake Goulding
reviews.text: Horrible... so first off we chose to try here as people have said they understand allergies and understand coeliac. We approached the server who was kind enough to tell us noodles and broths can be swapped to be as accommodating as possible. She assured us that our server will take us through the menu and help assure we are taken care of. If that would have happened I wouldnt be writing this. First of all, we was sat down and not a single server attended us for about 15 minutes, we was confused as we was handed a wallet at the start and all dishes apart from nagiri was containing gluten, when someone finally arrived to take orders, we had to explain our confusion and also explain that the wallet said nothing was gluten free, she explained that the vegitarian dish is the only gluten free dish... coeliacs arent rabbits! Now this wouldnt have been a big deal but we waited for 15 minutes to have someone "help us" 15 minutes of waiting to hear they dont accommodate and have no dishes other then raw fish and a veggie ramin. Avoid here if you have an allergy!

reviews.author: Natalie Louise Felton
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we left feeling quite disappointed with our experience at Maki and ramen, particularly as we had chosen to come here to celebrate our anniversary and were looking forward to it. We were seated in what felt like a tucked-away corner and unfortunately seemed to be forgotten about. It took around 25 minutes for anyone to come over and serve us, despite approximately 5 members of staff walking past us during that time. Unfortunately, the service didn’t improve after that. It then took a further 30 minutes for us to receive our drinks, and we had to remind the staff twice that we had actually ordered them even getting our food before our drinks... We completely understand that restaurants can get busy, especially as this is new to west Quay but it was difficult to understand how our table could be overlooked for so long when there were so many staff members walking passed us. To make matters worse, when we eventually asked for the bill, we felt like we were suddenly being hovered over by staff, which made the experience feel even more uncomfortable. It was a very different level of attention compared with when we were waiting to be served. We had been looking forward to having a nice day together. Unfortunately, feeling like we had been shoved into a corner and forgotten about for such a significant part of the meal really put a dampener on what was supposed to be a special occasion. Hopefully this was just an off day, but based on our experience, the service really needs some attention. We expected a much more attentive and welcoming experience, especially when celebrating something special. I wouldn’t rush back here.
